issues.claim: Нужна реализация-заглушка или условие в файле проекта.
issues.problem: The suggested fix is terse. An extra target without a platform needs a stub partial implementation compiled into that target. Alternatively the platform-neutral target can be dropped from the multi-target list. A reader might not see what the condition in the project file does.
issues.suggestedFix: Rewrite as: 'Нужна реализация-заглушка для такой цели (файл без платформенного суффикса, который компилируется только для неё) или отказ от такого целевого фреймворка.' Make the same change in the en answer.

issues.claim: OnNavigatedTo runs on the page that became the target of navigation. After back navigation the revealed list page is the target, so this method repeats too
issues.problem: None of the fetched excerpts show that NavigatedTo/OnNavigatedTo is raised on the revealed page after a pop. The Page API excerpt only lists OnNavigatedTo as 'immediately after the page was navigated to'. The NavigationPage excerpt shows modal navigation and has no 'Page navigation events' section. The repair notes also say the author is not certain that this section exists.
issues.suggestedFix: Either confirm the claim on the full NavigationPage page, or cite a page that states it. If it cannot be confirmed, soften it in both locales to 'OnNavigatedTo is raised when the page becomes the navigation target and may run again on return; check it on your target platforms', and drop the NavigationPage source if it does not support the claim. Apply the same change to locales.ru.answer.

issues.claim: OnAppearing runs when the page is about to become visible: on the first display and again when the detail page is closed.
issues.problem: The Page API excerpt supports that OnAppearing exists ('immediately prior to the page becoming visible'). No excerpt shows that it fires again on back navigation to a page that stays in the stack. The ContentPage link, which is listed first, contains only properties and no lifecycle information.
issues.suggestedFix: Cite the part of the Page API reference or lifecycle documentation for the Appearing event that shows this behaviour. Alternatively add a short note that it is observed behaviour on NavigationPage and Shell stack navigation. Consider dropping the ContentPage link, which supports none of the lifecycle claims.

issues.claim: `Shell.Current.GoToAsync("..", parameters)` with navigation data, received in `IQueryAttributable.ApplyQueryAttributes`
issues.problem: The Shell navigation excerpt shows passing and receiving navigation data, including ShellNavigationQueryParameters. It does not show passing data while navigating backwards with `..`. The excerpt does show that data is received again on back navigation.
issues.suggestedFix: Confirm the 'backwards navigation with data' passage in the Shell navigation page, or keep the wording as 'GoToAsync with the `..` route and a parameters dictionary' and cite that passage.
